crop_video_clip: crop a video clip to a specified region given height, width, and offset coordinates
resize_video_clip: resize a video clip to a target size using bilinear or nearest interpolation
normalize_video_clip: normalize a torch tensor video clip by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation
compute_resize_dimensions: compute output height and width for resizing while preserving aspect ratio
check_tensor_clip: check whether a tensor has 4 dimensions representing a video clip
